name: secure-centric/consultant-scorer
title: Secure-Centric Consultant Selection Scorer (7 Checks)
description: Interactive 7-point decision matrix scorecard for choosing a CMMC advisory firm.

title.default: How to choose a CMMC consultant: 7 key points

subtitle.default: Choosing a consultant for a sales presentation alone makes it difficult to compare firms. Apply the same checks to every provider.

resultDesc.default: The perfect choice is the firm that can explain how your engagement will run, show useful work samples, name the people responsible, and state what it will not do.

checksData.default: [{"label":"Verify Cyber AB status","desc":"Confirm the organization's current listing and ask which credentialed people will work on your account."},{"label":"Ask who owns the engagement","desc":"You should know the name and role of your day-to-day CMMC advisor before signing."},{"label":"Request a written scope method","desc":"The provider should explain how it traces contracts, CUI, systems, users, facilities, and outside services."},{"label":"Inspect sample deliverables","desc":"Review redacted examples of an SSP section, gap register, evidence request, or remediation tracker."},{"label":"Separate preparation from assessment","desc":"A consultant prepares you. An independent C3PAO performs the official Level 2 certification assessment."},{"label":"Define the implementation boundary","desc":"Ask which tasks the consultant performs, which belong to your IT team or MSP, and how work is validated."},{"label":"Check how evidence is managed","desc":"Ask where evidence is stored, how it is linked to requirements, and how environment changes are recorded."}]
